user.title: Connect FRITZ!Box
user.description: Credentials of a FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission. TR-064 must be enabled under Home Network > Network > Network Settings > "Allow access for applications".

data.port: Port (optional, defaults depend on the TLS setting)

data_description.host: Name or IP address of the FRITZ!Box in your network, e.g. fritz.box or 192.168.178.1.
data_description.username: FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.
data_description.use_tls: Encrypt the connection to the FRITZ!Box. The certificate is not verified, as the box signs it itself.
data_description.port: Leave empty to use the default (49000 without TLS, 49443 with TLS).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to the FRITZ!Box again
reauth_confirm.description: The FRITZ!Box {host} rejected the stored credentials. Please enter new credentials.

data_description.username: FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.

reconfigure.title: Change the FRITZ!Box connection
reconfigure.description: Adjust host, port, encryption or credentials. It has to remain the same FRITZ!Box.

data.port: Port (optional, defaults depend on the TLS setting)

data_description.host: Name or IP address of the FRITZ!Box in your network, e.g. fritz.box or 192.168.178.1.
data_description.username: FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.
data_description.use_tls: Encrypt the connection to the FRITZ!Box. The certificate is not verified, as the box signs it itself.
data_description.port: Leave empty to use the default (49000 without TLS, 49443 with TLS).

discovery_confirm.title: Set up the FRITZ!Box {name}
discovery_confirm.description: A FRITZ!Box was found at {host}. Enter the credentials of a FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.

data_description.username: FRITZ!Box user with the telephony permission.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the FRITZ!Box.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong username or password, or the user lacks the telephony permission.

abort.wrong_device: A different FRITZ!Box answers under these details than the one originally set up.
abort.no_host: The address of this FRITZ!Box could not be determined.
abort.no_telephony: This device (for example a repeater) has no telephone function.

data.call_history_days: Keep a call history on disk (days, 0 = off)
data.enable_call_monitor: Enable the call monitor (real-time call state)
data.prefixes: Country prefixes for number matching (e.g. +49), comma separated; empty = country of Home Assistant
data.phoneblock_enabled: Enable PhoneBlock spam detection (free account on phoneblock.net required)
data.phoneblock_spam_threshold: Spam threshold (%, a number counts as spam from this spam probability)
data.reverse_lookup_enabled: Enable online reverse lookup via Tellows (sends unknown phone numbers in clear text to tellows.de, no account needed)
data.privacy_mode: Hide names and numbers in the dashboard card until a row is tapped (for wall tablets)

data_description.scan_interval: How often the call list, answering machine and phonebooks are read from the FRITZ!Box.
data_description.call_list_days: Calls older than this are not loaded.
data_description.call_list_max: Upper limit of calls kept in the call list sensor.
data_description.call_history_days: Merges every call list into a longer history for the statistics of a panel, deduplicated and kept for this many days (at most 365). The call records (numbers, names, times) are then stored in Home Assistant's .storage folder and in its backups. 0 deletes the stored history.
data_description.enable_call_monitor: Needs the call monitor enabled on the FRITZ!Box (dial #96*5* on a connected phone).
data_description.callmonitor_port: TCP port of the FRITZ!Box call monitor, normally 1012.
data_description.prefixes: Used to recognise the same number written differently, e.g. 030 123456 and +49 30 123456.
data_description.phoneblock_enabled: Looks up unknown callers on phoneblock.net. Only a hash of the number is sent.
data_description.phoneblock_password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
data_description.phoneblock_spam_threshold: Callers at or above this spam probability are marked as spam.
data_description.reverse_lookup_enabled: Sends unknown numbers in clear text to tellows.de to find a name and a rating.

error.phoneblock_credentials_required: PhoneBlock is enabled, but the username and/or password are missing.

mark_message_read.name: Mark message as read
mark_message_read.description: Marks an answering machine message as read or unread.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

read.name: Read
read.description: On = mark as read, off = mark as unread.

message_key.name: Message key
message_key.description: Optional 'key' of the message (same attribute list). The action is refused if the box has renumbered its messages and the key no longer matches.

delete_message.name: Delete message
delete_message.description: Permanently deletes an answering machine message on the FRITZ!Box.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

message_key.name: Message key
message_key.description: Optional 'key' of the message (same attribute list). The action is refused if the box has renumbered its messages and the key no longer matches.

download_message.name: Download message
download_message.description: Deprecated: saves the recording as a file under config/www/fritzbox_tam/. These files can be fetched without logging in - the card plays recordings signed in, straight from the FRITZ!Box, instead. Only file names ending in .wav, .mp3 or .ogg are accepted.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

message_key.name: Message key
message_key.description: Optional 'key' of the message (same attribute list). The action is refused if the box has renumbered its messages and the key no longer matches.

dial.name: Dial a number
dial.description: Starts a call with the FRITZ!Box dial help: the phone chosen there rings first, and the number is dialed once you pick up. The dial help must be enabled on the box.

hangup.name: Cancel dialing
hangup.description: Cancels a call that was started with the dial action and has not been answered yet.

lookup_number.name: Look up a number
lookup_number.description: Returns what is known about a phone number: phonebook contact, area, PhoneBlock spam rating and Tellows reverse lookup (when enabled).

block_number.name: Block a number
block_number.description: Adds a number to the FRITZ!Box call barring: calls from it are rejected by the box. The block can be lifted with the "Unblock a number" action or in the box settings.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional label shown in the box's call barring list. Defaults to the number.

unblock_number.name: Unblock a number
unblock_number.description: Removes a number from the FRITZ!Box call barring.

play_message.name: Play a message on a speaker
play_message.description: Plays an answering machine recording on a media player. The speaker needs to reach Home Assistant at its internal URL; the address is signed and valid for ten minutes.

message_index.name: Message index
message_index.description: Index of the message (see the 'messages' attribute of the answering machine sensor).

message_key.name: Message key
message_key.description: Optional 'key' of the message (same attribute list). The action is refused if the box has renumbered its messages and the key no longer matches.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: The speaker that plays the message.

add_contact.name: Add a contact
add_contact.description: Adds a contact with one number to a FRITZ!Box phonebook, e.g. for a caller the call list shows as unknown. Numbers that are already in a phonebook are refused.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name the contact gets in the phonebook.

phonebook_id.name: Phonebook
phonebook_id.description: Number of the phonebook (0 is the main phonebook).

not_answering_machine.message: This action only works with the sensors of an answering machine.

box_request_failed.message: The FRITZ!Box did not carry out the request: {error}

device_required.message: More than one FRITZ!Box is set up - please choose the device.

no_box.message: No FRITZ!Box is set up or loaded.

number_not_blocked.message: The number {number} is not on the FRITZ!Box call barring list.

message_not_playable.message: Message {index} has no recording that could be played.

no_internal_url.message: No internal Home Assistant URL is set, so a speaker cannot fetch the recording. Set it under Settings > System > Network.

contact_exists.message: {number} is already in the phonebook as {name}.

phoneblock_credentials_rejected.title: PhoneBlock rejects the login
phoneblock_credentials_rejected.description: PhoneBlock did not accept the username or password for several requests in a row, so no spam ratings are being fetched. Open the integration's options (Settings → Devices & services → FRITZ!Box Telefon → Configure) and check the PhoneBlock username and password, or switch the spam check off.
